为了节约上下文 handoff 新开 Session，这在半年一年前是很好的实践，现在没太有必要，因为 codex 自己上下文压缩做的很好了，或者 /compact 一下继续就足够了。

当然如果关系不大的任务，还是新开 Session 更好。

当然除此之外 handoff 还是适用于跨 Agent session 的，比如 Claude Code https://t.co/rj10QSqElm

我一直觉得这种测试只能测试 SVG 画图能力，并不太能体现智能水平，或者有什么理由通过这个测试能反映智能水平？

I continue to think that a lack of verifiable answers in many fields is a real issue for LLMs but not as big a problem as it sometimes is made out to be.

As models are getting better at formal domains, they also are getting better at lots of other less-verifiable domains as well https://t.co/rTXKjwiEga

Like if your marketing project required a bit of coding or a financial excel model or solution to higher dimensional sphere packing you used to need to call the engineering department or the financial analysts or your firm’s theoretical math department but now you just ask an AI.
And yet they still stink at good long-form fiction.
